pass_rule: no conflicts anywhere; 5|2 and 6|1: every slot of the partition gets a block and all chains match after it; 4|3 and 3|2|2: no commit during the partition, commits resume after it; flapping and every delay: all chains complete and equal, every delay: every slot gets a block
known_issues: messages across a partition are dropped, not queued; nothing is re-sent except by the protocol's own later rounds and the catch-up of decided heights
jamming takes a node's link down for both directions; a validator whose link is down at the end of the run may still be missing the last heights (not checked)
the theory column is the share of time at least Q validators are up; a slot can still get a block when Q come up only later in the slot, so the measured share can lie above it
